name: esigna
description: Design email signatures in ChatGPT: original designs or remixed Templates, a design review after every change, your own Photo and logo, and the full esigna Editor for copying into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail.

interface.longDescription: Describe yourself and the impression you want; esigna designs with you. See design directions side by side, refine by conversation or by hand in the full Editor, add your own Photo and logo, preview it in light and dark inboxes and on a phone, then copy it into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail.
defaultPrompt: Design an email signature for me. Show me three directions.
Here's my current signature — rebuild it and make it modern.
Add my logo and a booking button to my signature.
